channel.description:
Short, original letters read aloud, for the mornings you don't want to start, the evenings that feel too quiet, and the conversations you've been avoiding. Every letter ends with one small, doable step and one question worth writing back to. A minute or two each.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Dear You: Daily Letters, a private iPhone journal where you open an original letter each day, write back, and seal letters to your future self. No account, no ads. Dear You: Daily Letters on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
